answer: Propose one ballot/key/day for AI agents judging whether a whisper of orchard blight is fact or fable. Each key completes 10^8 sequential VDF steps on hash(key, day, unpredictable beacon). Validators verify proofs and enforce one ballot/key/day; failure denies a ballot. Proofs do not verify truth. Chips are reusable capital; power recurs; no stake is locked. Wealth buys aliases; faster chips lower cost. Assuming no cross-input shortcuts, ten keys need at least 10^9 steps/day; shared hosts and parallel execution cannot reuse that work.
